title: Closed models [notes postérieures à PS ?] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. A is a small category, Δ is the simplex category, and e is the final (point) category. Grothendieck draws the square of projections A×Δ → A, A×Δ → Δ, A → e, Δ → e. Following the next page's convention, p_Δ: A×Δ → A forgets Δ and p_A: A×Δ → Δ forgets A. There is a matching square of direct-image functors on presheaf categories: (A×Δ)^ → A^, (A×Δ)^ → Δ^, and both down to (Ens).

Objects. An object X_* of (A×Δ)^ is identified with a simplicial presheaf on A, via (A×Δ)^ ≃ Hom(Δ°, A^) ≃ Hom(A°, Δ^). He marks the subcategory of simplicial objects of A (embedded by Yoneda) as SA = Hom(Δ°, A).

Three levels of Hom. Using the internal Hom of the presheaf topos (A×Δ)^, he defines:
- the absolute Hom: Hom_{A×Δ}(X,Y) = Γ_{A×Δ}(internal Hom);
- a Hom relative to A: Hom_A(X,Y) = p_{Δ*}(internal Hom), a presheaf on A;
- a Hom relative to Δ: Hom_Δ(X,Y) = p_{A*}(internal Hom), a simplicial set.

Computing the direct images. These are correct:
- p_{Δ*}X_* = X_0. Indeed p_Δ^*(a) is represented by (a,[0]) because [0] is final in Δ, so (p_{Δ*}X)(a) = X(a,[0]).
- p_{A*}X_* = (Γ_A X_n)_n, because (p_{A*}X)_n = Hom(e_A ⊠ Δ[n], X) = lim_A X_n.
- The total direct image to (Ens) is Γ_A X_0.
Consequently Hom_Δ(X,Y)_n = Hom(X × Δ[n], Y). This is the standard simplicial enrichment of simplicial presheaves. Hom_A(X,Y) is the A-presheaf a ↦ Hom(h_a ⊠ Δ[0] × X, Y).

The question posed. For L in A (more generally L in A^), what are the levelwise objects (Hom_A(L,X_n))_n in (A×Δ)^ and (Hom(L,X_n))_n in Δ^ intrinsically? The second is the image of the first under p_{A*} (Γ_A applied componentwise).

Claims. Regard L as the constant simplicial presheaf p_Δ^*(L).
- (I) (Hom_A(L,X_n))_n = Hom_{A×Δ}(p_Δ^*L, X_*), an internal Hom.
- (I') Applying p_{A*}: (Hom(L,X_n))_n = Hom_Δ(p_Δ^*L, X_*).
Verification: at (a,[n]) one has Hom((h_a ⊠ Δ[n]) × p_Δ^*L, X) = Hom((h_a × L) ⊠ Δ[n], X) = Hom_{A^}(h_a × L, X_n) = Hom_A(L,X_n)(a).

Margin and purpose. The left margin, written sideways, sketches the same check with notation X(a,b) = M(b), {b} → I, Hom(a_1,a_0) → u(b). The next page generalizes everything to A×B and the evaluation functors Γ''_b. The page is struck through with two long diagonal lines, i.e. superseded by that next page. Its purpose is to set up the tensor/cotensor/relative-Hom formalism (X⊗M, X^M, Hom_A, Hom_B) needed for simplicial (SM7-type) structures on closed model categories of simplicial presheaves.
errors: No mathematical errors. The bottom-left node of the first diagram is A, not Δ, as the arrows and the next page's conventions make clear. The whole page is crossed out with diagonal strokes, apparently because it is redone more generally on the next page.

ideas.what: Viewing simplicial presheaves as presheaves on A×Δ and obtaining the simplicial enrichment and A-relative Hom as direct images of the internal Hom along the projections
ideas.modern_name: Simplicial enrichment / simplicial mapping spaces of simplicial presheaves; topos-theoretic relative Hom (direct image of internal Hom)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Quillen (simplicial model categories, 1967); simplicial presheaves: Brown–Gersten (1973), Joyal (1984 letter), Jardine (1987); the topos formalism goes back to SGA4
ideas.where_published: The topos formalism is in SGA4; similar manipulations of A×Δ presheaves may occur in Pursuing Stacks / Les Dérivateurs (unsure)

ideas.what: Identity Hom_{A×Δ}(p_Δ^*L, X_*) = (Hom_A(L,X_n))_n, and its Γ-version
ideas.modern_name: Cotensor/levelwise Hom with a constant simplicial object (Yoneda computation)

deep.surprise_reason: This is routine bookkeeping of direct images and internal Homs for presheaves on A×Δ, i.e. the standard simplicial enrichment of simplicial presheaves. It is all correct but well known, and the page is crossed out in favour of the next.
transcription_corrections: First diagram: the bottom nodes are 'A' (left) and 'Δ' (right), not 'Δ Δ'.
'for given L ∈ Ob A^' – the image suggests 'L ∈ Ob A' with the parenthetical '(more generally, L ∈ Ob A^ ?)'.
'hence, by applying p_{A*}' – the illegible word before p_{A*} is a crossed-out start, not mathematical content.
The whole page is struck through by two long diagonal pencil lines; the transcription does not mention this.
The top-right block is enclosed by drawn lines and includes Γ_A X_0 at the end of (q_Δ p_A)_*(X_*) = (q_A p_Δ)_*X_* = Γ_A X_0.
